# Was the Staples Canada print website breach a hack?

**Confirmed.** Yes, by Staples' own account: an unknown party got into staplesprint.ca without permission between Nov 1 and Nov 5 and had access to customer information. Who did it is not known.

Incident: Staples Canada print website breach, Nov 2026. Also reported as the staplesprint.ca breach and the Staples Print hack. First published Nov 21, 2026; last updated Nov 21, 2026, 12:36 AM ET.

> **Not verified: initial investigation only.** Nothing on this page is absolutely confirmed. It is an early look based only on publicly available sources, and it should not be treated as verified fact. Even items labeled "Confirmed" only mean a public source reports them. Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Staples, any government agency, news outlet, company, or anyone else named.

This is the current answer, not a final verdict.

## The latest

Nov 21, 2026, 12:36 AM ET: **Staples says it removed the intruder and secured all accounts, and that no other Staples website was affected.** Story agent run. Added 2 Tier 2 sources: Agence QMI (s006, Journal de Québec; not re-read: access blocked, text seen in a public search index) and The Canadian Press (s007, Winnipeg Free Press). Correction: s003 Les Affaires is The Canadian Press, so its independence group is now canadian-press (c001 to c004 stay Confirmed on CBC and Global News). Label changes: c005 password reset Reported to Confirmed (Global News, QMI); c006 other websites not affected Reported to Confirmed (CBC, Canadian Press); c007 investigation Reported to Confirmed (CBC, Global News, Canadian Press). New c012 (Confirmed): intruder removed, accounts secured. Still no public Staples page (staplesprint.ca home page shows no notice; staples.ca not checked: access blocked), no privacy-regulator notice, no count, no attacker or method. Staleness check done: main answer, known, not known, size and figures still true; known gains c012. Privacy check done: no names of private people, no handles, no contact details.

## At a glance

- Status: monitoring
- Size: Local. One print-ordering website in Canada. Staples has not said how many customers were affected.
- Who is affected: Customers of staplesprint.ca whom Staples emailed. Their names, emails, addresses, order summaries and encrypted passwords were involved. Staples says no financial information was.

| Value | What | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| Nov 1-5 | Access window | Per Staples' notice |

### Known so far

- An unknown party got into staplesprint.ca without permission and reached customer information.
- The access happened between Nov 1 and Nov 5, 2026.
- Names, emails, shipping and billing addresses, order summaries and encrypted passwords were involved.
- Staples says no financial information was exposed.
- Staples says it removed the intruder and secured all accounts.

### Not known yet

- How many customers were affected.
- Who was behind it.
- How they got in.
- Whether it has any link to the separate claim against Staples, Inc.
